title: Conversion UX Strategist
description:
Indeed Job Title

**Conversion UX Strategist – Funnel Planning, Landing Pages & AI-Assisted UI**

Job Description

**Please read before applying:** This is not a traditional website designer or website developer role. We are looking for someone who thinks strategically before opening a design tool. You should understand the client’s business, identify the campaign goal, plan the customer journey, and design landing pages that generate enquiries.

You will plan and design conversion-focused landing pages for our advertising campaigns. The process starts with research and strategy, followed by client approval, AI-assisted UI design, launch coordination, and performance improvement.

**Thinking and planning come first. Design comes second.**

What You’ll Do

**1. Business & Campaign Research**

* Understand the client’s business, primary product or service, unique selling proposition (USP), and competitive advantages.
* Identify the campaign objective, whether it is phone calls, WhatsApp enquiries, form submissions, bookings, or another conversion action.
* Research the target audience, their needs, pain points, objections, and reasons to trust a business.
* Review competitor landing pages and advertisements to identify gaps, opportunities, and effective approaches.

**2. Funnel & Customer Journey Planning**

* Plan the complete journey from advertisement to landing page, enquiry form, and thank-you page.
* Ensure the landing-page message matches the advertisement and the visitor’s expectations.
* Decide what visitors need to see and understand at each stage before taking action.
* Plan the conversion flow to reduce friction and make enquiring as straightforward as possible.

**3. Landing-Page Structure & Content Strategy**

* Define the page structure, including headlines, offers, benefits, trust points, testimonials, reviews, certifications, and calls to action.
* Decide the purpose and placement of each section based on the campaign goal and audience intent.
* Plan the messaging hierarchy so visitors quickly understand the offer and its value.
* Identify missing information and ask the client the right questions before finalizing the strategy.

**4. Strategy Documentation & Client Approval**

* Prepare a clear strategy document explaining the campaign objective, audience, offer, conversion goal, and recommended customer journey.
* Create page outlines and wireframes to communicate the proposed structure.
* Explain the purpose of each section, the messaging direction, trust elements, and CTA strategy.
* Present the plan to the client and obtain approval before starting the final design.
* Incorporate feedback and finalize the approved direction.

**5. AI-Assisted Landing-Page Design**

* Use AI design tools to turn the approved strategy and wireframes into landing-page UI designs.
* Create clean, conversion-focused, mobile-first page layouts.
* Ensure the visual hierarchy supports the messaging and primary conversion action.
* Maintain consistency between the advertisement, landing-page content, and overall campaign offer.
* Refine the design based on usability, clarity, and conversion objectives.

**6. Launch Coordination & Performance Improvement**

* Collaborate with the advertising team and developers to coordinate page launch.
* Help ensure enquiry forms, calls, WhatsApp links, thank-you pages, and conversion tracking work correctly.
* Review campaign and landing-page performance after launch.
* Identify possible friction points and recommend changes to improve enquiry volume and quality.
* Use available results and performance data to guide optimization decisions.

Tools & Platforms

AI-assisted UI design tools, wireframing tools, Google Docs, analytics and conversion-tracking tools, landing-page platforms, and collaboration tools used by the design, advertising, and development teams.

Experience

Experience in conversion rate optimization (CRO), UX strategy, landing-page planning, funnel strategy, or conversion-focused UI design is preferred. Candidates should be able to show how they planned a landing page around a specific campaign goal and, where available, explain the results it achieved.

Who Can Apply

* UX strategists and conversion rate optimization specialists.
* Landing-page strategists with experience supporting paid advertising campaigns.
* Digital marketing professionals who understand audience intent, funnels, and lead generation.
* UI designers who approach projects through research, strategy, and wireframing before visual design.
* Candidates comfortable using AI tools to develop wireframes and UI efficiently.

Skills

* Landing-page strategy and funnel planning.
* Business, audience, and competitor research.
* Conversion-focused content structure and messaging.
* Wireframing and information architecture.
* CTA planning and conversion-flow optimization.
* AI-assisted UI design and mobile-first thinking.
* Strategy documentation and client presentations.
* Collaboration with advertising teams and developers.
* Basic understanding of analytics, enquiry tracking, and conversion metrics.
* Critical thinking, independent decision-making, and clear communication.

This Role Is NOT for You If

* Your primary work is building websites on WordPress, Shopify, or Wix, or coding in HTML/CSS.
* You start projects by selecting a template or designing before understanding the business goal.
* Your portfolio contains only website screenshots without explaining the strategy, objectives, or results.
* You have never prepared a strategy document or presented a structured plan for client approval.

This Role IS for You If

* You ask, “What is the goal, and who is the audience?” before opening a design tool.
* You can explain why each section of a landing page exists and how it supports conversion.
* You have planned landing pages for advertising campaigns and can discuss their performance where data is available.
* You can prepare a clear strategy document that a client can understand and approve.
* You are comfortable using AI tools to create wireframes and UI quickly without skipping the strategic thinking.

**Application note:** Please share relevant landing-page or funnel projects and briefly explain the goal, your planning process, and the outcome. A portfolio showing your thinking is more valuable than screenshots alone.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

* Anand Vihar, Delhi, Delhi: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

title: Conversion UX Strategist
description:
Conversion UX Strategist – Landing Page Strategy & CRO

Job Description

We are looking for a **Conversion UX Strategist** who can independently research a client’s business, understand its target audience, and develop a complete landing page strategy focused on conversions.

You will translate business goals and campaign objectives into a clear landing page journey, deciding what information visitors need, how the content should flow, which objections must be addressed, and where calls to action should appear.

This is a **strategy-first role, not a website design or development role**. You should be comfortable conducting research, structuring content, writing strategic recommendations, explaining conversion decisions, and presenting your plan for client approval before design begins.

We value practical thinking, strong written communication, and the ability to create a well-reasoned landing page plan from scratch without relying on a ready-made layout or predefined section list.

What You’ll Do1. Business, Audience & Competitor Research

* Understand the client’s business model, products or services, target customers, and campaign objectives.
* Research the target audience, customer intent, pain points, motivations, objections, and decision-making factors.
* Analyze competitor landing pages and relevant market messaging to identify opportunities for differentiation.
* Determine what information potential customers need before taking action.
* Identify gaps in the available business information and ask focused questions to clarify the strategy.

2. Landing Page Strategy & Conversion Planning

* Plan the complete landing page journey from the first screen to the final call to action.
* Decide the most appropriate section structure and content sequence based on the campaign goal and customer intent.
* Define what visitors should understand, feel, and do at each stage of the page.
* Establish the messaging direction, content hierarchy, CTA placement, and conversion flow.
* Identify the trust signals, proof points, testimonials, case studies, credentials, and other credibility elements needed to build confidence.
* Address customer objections and information gaps through the recommended page structure.
* Develop the strategy independently rather than waiting for a client-provided layout, section list, or design reference.

3. Content Structure & Messaging Direction

* Define the purpose and required content of every recommended landing page section.
* Plan headline direction, supporting messages, benefit statements, proof points, and calls to action.
* Determine how product or service features should be communicated in terms of customer benefits and business value.
* Recommend the information hierarchy so visitors can understand the offer quickly and navigate the page logically.
* Ensure the messaging aligns with the audience, advertising campaign, offer, and desired conversion action.
* Provide clear content guidance that designers and AI design tools can use to turn the approved strategy into a landing page.

4. Strategy Documentation & Client Approval

Before design begins, prepare a structured Google Doc that presents the complete landing page strategy for client review and approval.

The document should cover:

* Client business overview and campaign objective
* Product or service being promoted
* Primary conversion goal and desired visitor action
* Target audience, customer intent, pain points, and objections
* Recommended landing page journey and section-by-section structure
* Purpose, content requirements, and information hierarchy of each section
* Messaging direction and headline recommendations
* CTA strategy and conversion flow
* Recommended trust, credibility, and proof elements
* Missing business information and questions requiring client input
* Strategic reasoning behind the proposed page structure and recommendations

You will explain why each major decision supports the client’s business objective and how the proposed page journey is intended to move visitors toward conversion.

5. Client Communication & Strategy Presentation

* Present landing page recommendations in clear, professional language.
* Explain the reasoning behind section order, messaging choices, CTA placement, and trust elements.
* Gather missing information from clients through focused questions.
* Incorporate relevant client feedback while maintaining a clear conversion strategy.
* Revise the strategy document based on feedback and secure approval before the design stage.
* Communicate the approved plan clearly to the team responsible for creating the landing page.

6. AI-Assisted Landing Page Workflow

* Prepare detailed, structured strategy documents that can be translated into landing pages using AI design tools.
* Ensure the approved strategy provides sufficient direction for page structure, content, messaging, and conversion elements.
* Review AI-generated page outputs against the approved strategy and identify gaps in the content flow or conversion logic.
* Recommend strategic improvements when the generated page does not adequately support the campaign objective.

Experience

Practical experience in conversion strategy, landing page planning, UX research, CRO, website content strategy, digital marketing strategy, or customer journey planning is preferred.

We are more interested in your **ability to independently develop a strong landing page strategy** than in your previous job title. Candidates who can demonstrate practical work, strategy documents, landing page analyses, or portfolio-quality thinking are encouraged to apply.

Who Can Apply

* Freshers and experienced candidates who can demonstrate strong strategic thinking and practical ability.
* Candidates with experience in landing page strategy, conversion rate optimization, UX research, content strategy, or digital marketing.
* Individuals who can research a business and its audience before recommending a page structure.
* Candidates who can plan a complete landing page journey from scratch without relying on templates or predefined layouts.
* People who can explain why each section, message, trust element, and CTA belongs on the page.
* Candidates with strong written communication and documentation skills.
* Individuals comfortable preparing structured Google Docs and presenting recommendations for client approval.
* Candidates interested in using AI design tools to turn approved strategies into landing pages.

Skills Required

* Landing page strategy and conversion planning
* Conversion rate optimization (CRO) fundamentals
* Business, audience, and competitor research
* Customer intent and objection analysis
* User journey and information architecture planning
* Content structuring and messaging strategy
* CTA strategy and conversion flow
* Trust and credibility element planning
* Strategic writing and Google Docs documentation
* Client communication and presentation
* Critical thinking and problem-solving
* AI-assisted landing page workflows

Important Role Clarification

This position is focused on **research, strategy, content planning, conversion logic, and client approval**. It is not primarily a graphic design, UI design, or website development role.

The ideal candidate can take a client brief, identify what is needed, ask the right questions, independently plan the full landing page, document and justify every major decision, and get the strategy approved before the page is designed using AI tools.

title: Graphic Designer - Architectural
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Company Name: Clear Bracket
Seniority level: Associate level

JobType: full\-time



**Location:** South Delhi


* **Experience:** 1 to 3 years
* **Work Mode:** Work from Office
* **Work Structure:** Five Days Working
* **Preferred Background:** B.Arch or Architecture or Spatial Design or Communication Design


**About the Role**

We are hiring a **Communication Designer** for a leading design\-led architecture practice.  

This role sits at the intersection of **architecture, storytelling, visual communication, and brand consistency**.  

The studio’s work needs to be communicated to different audiences — clients, students, media, design juries, institutions, and collaborators. Each audience reads architecture differently. A client looks for value and trust. A student looks for process. A media platform looks for narrative. A design jury looks for intent, clarity, and rigour.  

That is why this role is best suited for someone who has studied or deeply understands architecture, but may not want to practise core architecture.  



**Why an Architecture Background Helps**  

This is not a typical graphic design role.  

  

You will work with:


* plans, sections, drawings, diagrams, renders, photographs, and project notes
* Architectural concepts, material stories, context, process, and spatial intent
* Project decks, award entries, website features, presentations, and design narratives
  


 To do this well, you need to understand what architects are trying to say before turning it into clear visual communication.  

A B.Arch background is valuable because the role requires someone who can read design intent, not just arrange text and images.


**What You Will Do**


* Create visual communication assets for presentations, website, social media, print, events, and digital platforms
* Support project features, award entries, pitch decks, and design presentations
* Translate architectural ideas into clear visual formats
* Work with principals and design teams to understand project intent
* Develop layouts using strong grid, typography, image treatment, and hierarchy
* Help maintain consistency across the studio’s communication material
* Support communication for talks, school presentations, project launches, and media features
* Work with drawings, renders, site images, process notes, and project stories


**What We Are Looking For**  

You may be a strong fit if you:


* Have a B.Arch or architecture / spatial design background
* Enjoy communication more than conventional architectural practice
* Can understand architectural drawings and design process
* Have strong visual layout and typography sense
* Are comfortable working with both images and text
* Are detail\-oriented and patient with refinement
* Can take feedback from senior design leaders
* Are curious about how architecture is made, presented, and remembered


**Skills Required**


* Visual Communication
* Layout Design
* Typography
* Image Editing
* Presentation Design
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe InDesign
* Adobe Photoshop
* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* Microsoft Office


**Good to Have**


* Writing ability
* Architectural journalism interest
* Award entry experience
* Social media content experience
* Videography / editing skills
* Basic motion graphics
* Familiarity with architectural publications or design media

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
